title: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
description:
With the Spotify music and podcast app, you can play millions of songs, albums and original podcasts for free. We have even added audiobooks, so you can enjoy thousands of stories wherever you are!

Stream music and podcasts, listen to audiobooks, discover albums, playlists or even single songs for free on your mobile or tablet. Subscribe to Spotify Premium to download and listen offline wherever you are.

Spotify gives you access to a world of free music, curated playlists, artists, and podcasts you love. Discover podcasts, new music, top songs or listen to your favorite artists and albums.

WHY SPOTIFY FOR MUSIC AND PODCASTS?
• Listen to over 80 million songs and 4 million podcasts (and counting)
• Enjoy over 300,000 newly added audiobook titles
• Discover new music, albums, playlists and original podcasts.
• Search for your favorite song or artist by typing a lyric
• Enjoy amazing sound quality on music and podcasts across all devices.
• Create and share your own music playlists to suit your mood or discover other playlists you might like.
• Listen to daily music mixes made just for you.
• Explore top songs from different genres, countries or decades.
• Subscribe to your favourite podcasts so that you never miss an episode, then curate your very own podcast library.
• Bookmark individual podcasts into Playlists
• Listen to music and podcasts on your mobile, tablet, desktop, PlayStation, Chromecast, TV, Wear OS or wearable device.

Listen and discover the latest music from artists like;
• Bad Bunny
• Billie Eilish
• Renzo Pianciola
• The Temper Trap
• Harry Styles

Listen to your favorite music artists all day every day via the Popular Radio playlist feature. Here are just some of the artists we’ve already curated;
• Taylor Swift
• Drake
• Eminem
• Coldplay
• Paolo Nutini
• Fleetwood Mac

Listen to over 40 category genres - New Releases, Charts, Live Events, Made for You, At Home, Only You, Summer, Pop, Workout, Hip-Hop, Mood, Party, Pride, Dance/Electronic, Alternative, Indie, Equal, Wellness, Rock, Frequency, R&B, Disney,, Throwback, Radar, Chill, Sleep, In the car, Kids & Family, Caribbean, Classical, Romance, Jazz, Instrumental, Afro, Christian and Gospel and Country.

Listen to popular and exclusive podcasts like;
• The Joe Rogan Experience
• Modern Wisdom
• 2 Bears, 1 Cave with Tom Segura and Bert Kreischer
• Call Her Daddy and Crime Junkie

Search, discover and play music, podcasts and audiobooks from all over the world for free, anywhere, anytime or create your own music playlists with the latest songs to suit your mood.

WHY GO PREMIUM?
• Listen to albums and playlists without ad breaks.
• Download and listen to music and podcasts offline, wherever you are.
• Jump back in and listen to your top songs with on-demand playback.
• Choose from 4 subscription options – Individual, Duo, Family, Student. There’s no commitment and you can cancel any time

Audiobooks in Premium currently available in Australia, the UK & the US. Discover 250,000+ titles, 15 hours/month of available listening for Premium Individual subscribers and Duo & Family plan managers.

Experience Spotify on your Wear OS device:
• Enjoy your favourite music and podcasts without having your phone around.
• Control playback on your phone or any of your Spotify compatible devices.
• Download your favourite content for offline listening on the go (Premium only).
• Get instant access to Spotify with our Tiles and Complications.

Please note: This app features Nielsen’s audience measurement software which will allow you to contribute to market research, such as Nielsen’s Audio Measurement. If you don't want to participate, you can opt-out within the app settings. To learn more about our digital audience measurement products and your choices in regard to them, please visit https://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information.

summary: Listen to songs, play podcasts, create playlists and discover music you'll love
comments: I LOVE Spotify, and as a user since circa 2013, I like to think I'm think I'm an early adopter and have a lot of experience with the app. That said, the last 6 months it's gone drastically downhill. The app constantly closes with no crash report, it just stops playing and it closes. Sometimes it's playing and the app is not even showing as open, which is fun. Sometimes, it's choppy and that may be a service issue but it's only been happening the last few months. Not sure what's going on!

Always loved this app. I pay for premium but you still add commercials even though I pay to not have commercials. Granted they can be skipped, but I don't EVEN WANT THEM THATS THE POINT OF PAYING NOT TO HAVE THEM, having the ability to skip is pointless when I have to pick up my phone a million times during a podcast to skip the stupid BOSE headphones commercials. Per Spotify they told me to contact customer support, which I have, and they've never responded or fixed it.

I absolutely love Spotify and have since 2008. I always pay for premium because I can't stand commercials. Reason for the 4 star rating is due to a reoccurring issue causing me to reinstall the app to fix it. Eventually i can only play 1 genre of music from my library. doesn't matter if I make a shuffle all playlist or select a specific song from different genre. it only affects my downloaded/liked songs. It could be 4 months or a year, it always seems to happen. It's very annoying.

I've been loyal to Spotify for over a decade. But it is not the same platform it used to be. It is impossible to discover small artists. My recommendations are clogged with popular sponsored artists, even ones I've BLOCKED. All the cool features and staff curated playlists are soulless AI garbage now that Spotify has laid off hundreds of employees. Adding songs to a playlist (my favorite feature) frequently crashes my phone. Premium rates rise. If I find a good alternative, I will switch.

Updated review after TRYING to listen to audio books. you get 15 hours even with premium and have to pay a ridiculous amount of 13$ per 10hours. I took that 13$ to audible and finished the book I was listening to and got even better deals to continue the series. I spent 6 dollars for the 2nd book in the series that was over 20hrs long. I would have paid 4 times that to listen to it on spotify. I suggest either update the business model or get rid of it completely before you lose business.

my opinion has fallen through the floor with spotify, as the price only keeps climbing and the usability only gets worse. I haven't been able to look up artists or albums in months something's always "went wrong"... same goes for anyone trying to send me a link to a song. songs I've never liked end up in my liked list and if I try to remove them, "something went wrong" so I have to keep listening to the song I didn't like in the first place. just useless.

This will be the first time in 12 yrs that I have been dissatisfied with Spotify. For about 2 months, now, Spotify has been glitching. I subscribe to premium and for a while I have to endure the music stopping between each song, often forcing me to push play or select next track. I am also unable to add songs to my playlists. The last 2 months of fiddling with my phone trying desperately to get this app to work properly has consumed a large amount of time I paid to save. Unsubscribing.

as of September 2026, this app is extremely difficult to use and will not play any of my playlists through without restarting or repeating multiple times certain songs. my algorithm is getting screwed because spotify is playing songs it thinks I need to listen too many times and not playing the music I actually enjoy listening too. Although I seem to be having a lot of issues with mobile streaming, the spotify support team has been more than willing to help out. That alone deserves something.

For the past few months this app is glitching with my Pixel Buds Pro. No other headphones. Youtube and SoundCloud have no issues. It's sounds like a CD skipping it's driving me absolutely insane. PS: Years long gripe, I've downloaded an album to my phone yet I have to wait for the tracklist to load? Go into offline mode and it's not a problem anymore. Why do you need to check the tracklist with the API every single time?

Afordable quality music for every emotional moments. Love! NOT THAT GREAT ANYMORE! Too many mistakes. First when playing my play list of over 100 songs it keeps repeating songs after maybe 20-30 songs. The search can't find what I'm looking for (even I tipe everything correctly). Most upsetting is that you can't copy or download your play lists or albums. But pricing is going up on time😏. From $10 to $13. Yes...I'm that long with Spotify. But thinking about other solutions.

Great music app. Easy to learn and control. Really good selection of tunes and artists. The audio quality, especially when I play over my television with surround sound and a big woofer. I do have, and always have had premium service which let's me download my music to my phone, which allows me to listen anywhere at any time. I do wish that Spotify would ease up on the annual increases in price, while I understand that a large part of the increases is to pay the ever increasing number of artists

I pay for Spotify every month. Still hear ads, yes I can get my phone out and skip them manually but I pay for no ads. I shouldn't have to manually skip when listening to anything other than music. I'm sick of ads being shoved down my throat. DO BETTER SPOTIFY. Started a free trail on YouTube. If the program goes away on that platform Spotify will be canceled.

several problems. with no service, if your app isn't already in offline mode, it won't open. It streams songs you have downloaded which causes stuttering when you don't have a solid connection. songs constantly disappear, and even when I'm connected to the Internet, the search function doesn't work half of the time. I could go on, but reviews only let you type so much

The Algorithm for song recommendation seems to have taken a nose dive in the past few months. on multiple occasions I have gotten the same songs in the exact same order from shuffle/DJ. The wording in som areas is very off putting and it makes me not want to do the exploratory dives have done in the past. When it seems like things are on the up and up, decisions are made to bring it back down to bedrock.

***Update: app now unusable on my Pixel 6 due to slowness. Solutions provided DO NOT WORK. "The selection of music is so vast. Once I got spotify my music taste "changed" drastically. What really happened was that I kept finding music that I connected with more and more. Sadly I no longer enjoy the music most people enjoy but I don't mind because the music I listen to now I connect with on a deeper level than ever before. And I wouldn't change that for a thing." definitely recommend getting it

I am a premium user. Was a great app until last week. Since the update, I cannot connect it to my Pioneer audio receiver in the car through the Spotify app. Bluetooth works but the app doesn't anymore. Some advice: When you send out updates, make sure your third party platforms (like Pioneer, Alpine etc...) receive it as well....but I'm sure you guys don't care as long as you're paid. Please fix this or I will be switching to Amazon music since they can import Spotify playlists.

Been using this app and service forever, paid premium. They are consistently focused on adding more complicated nonsense features than useful, user friendly features for organizing and listening to music. I don't want audiobooks or podcasts all in the same app. The family plan and my huge library are about the only reasons I'm still here.

Good app. I really like how well the gapless playback works. Unfortunately they will sometimes swap out a song you have in a playlist with a different version of the song. Maybe it's a different album, or maybe it's a live performance, or maybe a censored radio edit. Who knows?

Best music app, period. I love the premium option for family. I got rid of SiriusXM because of it. I wish there were some hidden tracks from certain albums I like but it still rates five stars. Update: This app was great but now all I see are discovery cards on the home screen. Update 2-bring back the old widget. the new one is super buggy and half the time I can't open Spotify from the widget

The app takes FOREVER to load the home screen and playlists. I have to attempt to load playlists and podcasts multiple times and most of the time it still doesn't load And it keeps telling me it doesn't have an internet connection even when I know I do. Not sure what's going on with it, but it is incredibly annoying, especially since I pay for premium and I have for a few years. I really hope these glitches get fixed soon.

title: WhatsApp
description:
WhatsApp from Meta is a FREE messaging and video calling app. It’s used by over 2B people in more than 180 countries. It’s simple, reliable, and private, so you can easily keep in touch with your friends and family. WhatsApp works across mobile and desktop even on slow connections, with no subscription fees*.
    
 
  Private messaging across the world
 
  Your personal messages and calls to friends and family are end-to-end encrypted. No one outside of your chats, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them.
 
 
  Simple and secure connections, right away 
 All you need is your phone number, no user names or logins. You can quickly view your contacts who are on WhatsApp and start messaging. 
 
 High quality voice and video calls 
 Make secure video and voice calls with up to 32 people for free*. Your calls work across mobile devices using your phone’s Internet service, even on slow connections. 
 
 Group chats to keep you in contact 
 Stay in touch with your friends and family. End-to-end encrypted group chats let you share messages, photos, videos and documents across mobile and desktop. 
 
 Stay connected in real time 
 Share your location with only those in your individual or group chat, and stop sharing at any time. Or record a voice message to connect quickly.
 
 
 Share daily moments through Status 
 Status allows you to share text, photos, video and GIF updates that disappear after 24 hours. You can choose to share status posts with all your contacts or just selected ones. 
 
 Use WhatsApp on your Wear OS watch to continue conversations, reply to messages, and take calls - all from your wrist. And, leverage tiles and complications to easily access your chats and send voice messages.   
 
 *In some regions, WhatsApp uses SMS verification to authenticate your phone number and secure transactions.
 *Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details.     
______________________________________________________________
 
 
 If you have any feedback or questions, please go to WhatsApp > Settings > Help > Contact Us.
  
 Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service  
 Learn more about messaging privately: https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy  
 Learn more about WhatsApp safety: https://www.whatsapp.com/security

comments: Since the update, I have not been able to connect my phone to my computer with the same phone number, and each time when I attempted to connect them, I have been getting knocked off WhatsApp saying, "this number can't use WhatsApp" and then it goes under review. To make matters worse, there is no one to contact since all their customer service is AI generated and no live person can help.

Currently using the "lock immediately" feature on WhatsApp and every time I enter my code to open the app it closes and it takes a couple tries before I amablento fully use the app. Also, I get notified of a message, when I go to check the message isn't there, but the notificattion still is, then I have to exit the app multiple times and go back to finally recieve the message. Please fix as it is frustrating to use.

In my own opinion, WhatsApp is a great app for communicating with family and any communities, it's pretty simple and easy to use once you understand the settings, but it would be better if there was an in-app browser, similar to messenger, for whenever someone sends a link, and you don't have to go into chrome or any browser app you have, since I've noticed in both the reviews and the people I know who use WhatsApp, they'd prefer in-app browsers as well. But overall, a really easy to use app!!𔘓

I've been using Whatsapp for years now, and it's a very good way to communicate with others! but there's one problem that there's this profile picture glitch that only one contact can't see my picture and neither do I,the problem is we didn't block each other or excluded each other, I hope you fix this problem soon! overall the app is very powerful and useful.

I love this app. It’s very easy to use, and I’ve been using it for years to stay connected with the people I love. But I really wish there was a feature that allows us to access call history in a deeper way....like being able to download or save parts of our voice calls or video calls (with permission, of course😅). Sometimes very wholesome and meaningful moments happen during calls, and we don’t think to record them at the time.

I used to appreciate this app alot, still do. But now that it's becoming very common for more and more people to use this app for calls aswell, it's become very obvious to me that -after all these years- the quality for voice calls is still unacceptable. There seems to be a constant risk of WhatsApp repeatedly "reconnecting to the network" even if both/all participants have full network signal. This applies to both, mobile internet aswell as WiFi. Very disappointing, would give 5* otherwise.

My experience with WhatsApp has been pleasant until very recently. Since the last update, when I share any link in a message, I can no longer add any caption or comment about the link before sharing (unlike before). From now on, I have to edit to insert commentary after sharing to say something about the link. Please fix this issue ASAP. Thanks.

The latest update which involves channels on Whatsapp is frustrating. It's a good idea but the way it's being arranged makes the interface not user friendly. I prefer the former version. I hardly find the status I want because of this so called channels thing update. Edit: The rearrangement makes sense now. I can access my contacts status and other features with ease currently. Thanks for the update.

I travel a lot so it's helped me keep in touch with ppl. The only complaint I have is that there are glitches with calling or text sounds. Quite often someone says they've been trying to call me and I see the notification but it didn't ring. Also, it would be nice if a deleted or edited message didn't say deleted /edited

The photo sending function is rather messed up after the update, despite clicking on "view more" to see all of my folders I only get a handful. Accidentally sending gifs while scrolling or without adding a caption is rather irritating due to the one click and send function and for the past few days whenever I search gifs I am met with "check your device's internet connection" which hardly goes away....

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Most useful messaging app ever! 💬✅ WhatsApp is my go-to app for chatting with friends, family, and classmates. It’s fast, simple, and works even on low networks 📶👏. I love features like voice messages, video calls, status updates, and group chats! 🗣️📞📸 The new privacy settings and disappearing messages are great too 🔒✨. Very helpful for school work, daily chats, and sharing photos or documents easily 📚📁. Only wish there were more fun themes or fonts, but overall it’s a must

Hello, the latest WhatsApp update has introduced changes that I find quite inconvenient. Earlier, status updates were displayed in a straightforward vertical list, which I preferred. Now, they’re arranged in a horizontal format, which feels less user-friendly. Additionally, the Updates tab is now filled with channels and their options, which I don’t find useful. The previous design was simpler and more practical. I hope WhatsApp reconsiders and brings back the older layout. Thanks

The Developers of WhatsApp app! Your work is amazing. Some suggestions are very well done, thank you 🙏 Some more suggestions please if you don't mind; 1. Polling feature would be able to show or hide who voted for the item/person (for more privacy when needed), the have auto generated report underneath polling station 2. Add more items on polling station, maybe up to 20 items per vote please 3. Make it possible to pin down polling station until voting is done

Very disappointed! My WhatsApp crashed suddenly without any reason and is not working at all. I have tried multiple times to restore, reinstall and restart my phone but nothing works. All my important chats and data are stuck. For an app used by billions, this kind of instability is unacceptable. No proper support or solution from the WhatsApp team. Worst experience ever. Please fix this bug immediately. 1 Star until it's resolved.

I like this app, the best. It's good for communication, helps to save on your phone bill and a great and easy way to send pictures, documents, music etc. It's very convenient With it's voice note feature. Makes for easier communication when you don't want to type or when you want to be more expressive.

the first thing you see on the app when logging on, is a whole page basically saying "ye we don't care, the issue is on your end. have you tried turning it on and off? well if that doesn't help, contact your provider i guess". i got in after trying again with the same parameters after waiting a couple minutes, so the issue clearly was clearly on the servers side. make it usable without hassle and ruining the first impression, please.

so if you send a text when only on mobile data from the drop down in notifications it won't send the message unless you open the app, mates iPhone 17 pro max has the same issue, beyond unacceptable. It also sometimes just doesn't alert you to message unless you actually open the app. who develops and maintains this app, actual children or? oh sorry it's all about having features no one wants and being atleast 2 years behind other messaging apps. fix. it!

The latest update ruined a basic feature: custom call ringtones. Previously, we could select any custom ringtone file saved on our device, but now there is no option to browse local files at all. Limiting ringtone options to system defaults is a huge step backward for user experience. Developer team, please bring back the file picker for call ringtones ASAP!

Subject: WhatsApp Voice Message Audio/Noise Issue I am experiencing a serious audio/noise issue when sending voice messages on WhatsApp. The voice contains excessive noise and distortion. I have checked the phone microphone using the built-in Recorder app, and the recording is completely clear. I also tested another WhatsApp Business account/app on the same device, and there is no audio problem there. The issue is temporarily resolved after restarting the phone, but it comes back again later.

So far, so good, n it works well. I have a suggestion, though: can there be an added feature to highlight unreplied messages in a chat that can be optional per each chat? People can skip vital messages by mistake in a rush n forget to reply them later on, which can lead to miscommunication. Keep up with the good work edit: thank you for putting the option
